duration: One weekend, online (Saturday 8am to Sunday 8pm Eastern)
name: 36 Hours to Save the World (Global Challenge Weekend)
what_you_do: Online weekend contest for teams of high school students. You research a global problem, pitch ideas, build a prototype and present to judges.
who_can_apply: High school students who can show they know English. The page says students 12 and younger are not allowed. Students who have already graduated are not allowed either.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 challenge was Oct 23 to 25, 2026. The next challenge is Mar 19 to 21, 2027. No registration date is posted yet.
how_to_apply: Spring sign-up is not open yet. Use the Notify me form on the Global Training Initiative page to get a message when it opens.
notes: Run by NC State, but open to students anywhere. The spring challenge covers Goals 12 and 16.
